text:
Eleanor: Thanks for coming — notes + recording here: https://drive.redwood.ai/all-hands/may-2024 Recording: https://zoom.redwood.ai/rec/def456. Dropping quick follow-ups so nothing slips.

Hana: Question from design: will the Console layout changes land in the same sprint as the rollout toggle?

Eleanor: Toggle UX is targeted for next sprint; broader Console layout changes are planned for the following cycle. We'll post the RFC in #design by EOD Tue.

Jae: On Dedicated latency SLAs: team is finalizing measurement hooks. We'll publish an example SLO doc and the metrics we'll expose in Console. Action: Jae to share SLO draft.

Ravi: Action: I'll put together a short ops runbook for Dedicated migration (DB config, cache priming, rollout steps). ETA Wed. @Priya can you coordinate docs publishing?

Priya: Yep, will coordinate. Also will add a small Troubleshooting FAQ to the Guide.

Liam: Finance note: committed capacity pricing tiers will be in the pricing board tomorrow. If sales needs a skeleton for conversations, ping me and I'll share a template.

Sofia: Sales asked whether we can show a short one-pager for customers explaining Dedicated vs Hosted. Can Marketing help produce that?

Eleanor: Marketing + Product to draft one-pager. @Hana can you own the visual?

Hana: Happy to. I'll sync with Sofia and Priya on copy.

all-hands-bot: Poll: How useful was the infra appendix? (33 votes) 1: meh, 2: ok, 3: very useful. Results posted in #all-hands.

Priya: Follow-up: can we get examples of model quantization tradeoffs in the Guide? people asked in Q&A.

Jae: Good call. I'll ask eng-ml to produce a short table of typical quality vs cost numbers for common models.

Ravi: Blocker: need a test cluster to validate migration tooling. @Eleanor can we allocate a small cluster this week?

Eleanor: Approved. Ravi, infra will provision a 4-GPU test cluster. Expect invite from eng-infra.

Liam: Heads-up: legal wants a sample DPA for Dedicated customers. Legal will draft and share with sales.

Sofia: Can we add a checklist for sales calls (SLA, data residency, SOC2 status)? would help align messaging.

Priya: I'll add a sales checklist to the docs and link the one-pager.

Eleanor: Summary of action owners: Jae (SLO + quant table), Ravi (ops runbook + test cluster verification), Hana (one-pager visuals), Priya (publish docs + checklist), Liam (pricing template + legal coordination). Please update the shared follow-up sheet: https://sheets.redwood.ai/d/1Y-followups by EOD Thu.

Hana: I'll schedule a 30-min design sync Thurs 11am to review the one-pager drafts.

Jae: Example command we demoed for gradual rollout:
```
rw rollout apply --target pool:dedicated --model redwood-medium-v3 --traffic 25%
```

Eleanor: Thanks all. If anything else comes up, add to the sheet or DM me. Closing thread for now.
